caption: The video showcases a white tabletop holding parallel rows of 3D-printed U-shaped holders in rainbow colors—magenta, red, orange, gold, yellow, light green, dark green, teal, purple, blue—each seating a white domino, with extra lines of plain white dominoes along the front-left and back-right edges. The magenta, red and orange holders already hold tilted or flat pieces in the opening frame, while most others stand upright. Under a fixed camera the staggered toppling continues across the scene. The gold piece tips early, then the yellow piece follows. The plain white line at the front-left edge collapses from its right end, each piece knocking the next until most lie flat. The light green holder's piece then tips and settles horizontal, followed by the dark green piece, which leans and drops the same way. Toward the close of the clip the teal holder's piece is seen tilting as well. The purple and blue pieces remain standing, and the toppling sequence is still continuing as the clip ends.
relations: A tipped holder piece leans toward its neighbor, knocking that next piece over in sequence.
The front-left white line collapses rightward, each falling domino striking the next until most lie flat.
Gold tipping triggers yellow, then light-green and dark-green pieces lean and settle horizontal in turn.
Near the end teal tilts while purple and blue pieces remain upright as toppling continues.
